name: Winged Behemoth Manticore
journal_prompt: An unnatural winged leopard with a human face, forged purely from brick-dust, shadow, and corrupted Asura mantras.
appearance: A colossal, shadowy manticore descended from corrupted sphinx-felids: the muscular body of a black leopard, flexible ape-like forelimbs, and broad membranous wings woven from brick-dust and shadow. Its strikingly expressive human face is crowned with scorpion-spine horns, and it can speak, in archaic dialects.
